title: Angels and Shepherds
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: That night, shepherds were in the fields near Bethlehem, keeping their sheep safe.
Suddenly an angel came, and bright light shone all around! The shepherds were afraid. The angel said, “Fear not! I bring good news of great joy.”
“Today a Savior is born, Christ the Lord. You will find Him wrapped in cloths, lying in a manger.”
p2: Many angels praised, “Glory to Heavenly Father, and on earth peace!” When they went back to heaven, the shepherds said, “Let’s go see!” They hurried and found Mary, Joseph, and baby Jesus. Then they told everyone.
At first the shepherds were afraid. Then the good news filled them with joy. Tonight, tell someone the happy news: Jesus was born!
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
